channel.title: Federal Register (fixture)
channel.description: Synthetic Phase 3c scoring fixture (docket source). Fictional notices modelled on the Federal Register's formulaic titles; see fixtures/README.md.

item.title: Notice of Availability of the Final Environmental Impact Statement for the Example River Hydroelectric Project
item.description: Take notice that the Commission has issued the final environmental impact statement for the relicensing of the 120 MW Example River hydroelectric project. Any person desiring to intervene must file a motion within 30 days. The project's power is sold to the regional utility.

item.title: Combined Notice of Filings: Example Utility application to serve a 500 MW large load data center campus
item.description: Take notice that Example Utility filed an application for a special contract to serve a 500 MW large load data center campus with a new 230 kV interconnection, including a tariff rider for transmission upgrades. Any person desiring to intervene must file a motion within 21 days.
